name: CI - Linux

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      BUILD_DIR: build

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source and submodules
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Ensure submodules are initialized and synced
        run: |
          git submodule sync --recursive
          git submodule update --init --recursive

      - name: Debug repo layout
        run: |
          echo "PWD=$(pwd)"
          ls -la
          echo "dep/"
          ls -la dep || true
          echo "Search vendored libs"
          find . -maxdepth 5 \( -type d -iname 'GLM' -o -type d -iname 'JPEGLIB' -o -type d -iname 'LIBPNG' \) -print || true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            build-essential \
            binutils-dev \
            cmake \
            ninja-build \
            pkg-config \
            libgl1-mesa-dev \
            libx11-dev \
            libxrandr-dev \
            libxinerama-dev \
            libxcursor-dev \
            libxi-dev \
            zlib1g-dev \
            libpng-dev \
            libjpeg-dev \
            libfreetype6-dev \
            libsdl2-dev \
            libvulkan-dev \
            libglm-dev \
            mesa-vulkan-drivers

      - name: Configure with CMake
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B "$BUILD_DIR" \
            -G "Ninja" \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DIRR_BUILD_RENDERSYSTEM_GL=1 \
            -DIRR_BUILD_RENDERSYSTEM_Vulkan=1 \
            -DBUILD_USE_SDL2=ON \
            -DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF \
            -DIRR_BUILD_NOESIS=OFF

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build "$BUILD_DIR" --parallel

      - name: Run CTest if available
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: |
          if [ -f "$BUILD_DIR/CTestTestfile.cmake" ]; then
            ctest --test-dir "$BUILD_DIR" --output-on-failure --parallel 2 || true
          else
            echo "No CTest configuration found."
          fi

      - name: Collect build outputs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: |
          set -e
          dest=artifacts
          rm -rf "$dest"
          mkdir -p "$dest"

          # Copy build folder
          if [ -d "$BUILD_DIR" ]; then
            echo "Copying build directory to $dest/build"
            cp -a "$BUILD_DIR" "$dest/build" || true
          else
            echo "No build directory found at $BUILD_DIR"
          fi

          # Find likely binaries: executable files, shared libs, archives
          echo "Searching for executables and libraries under $BUILD_DIR"
          find "$BUILD_DIR" -type f \( -perm /111 -o -name '*.so' -o -name '*.a' -o -name '*.so.*' -o -name '*.dll' -o -name '*.out' -o -name '*.elf' \) -print0 |
            xargs -0 -I{} sh -c 'mkdir -p "$(dirname "artifacts/{}")"; cp -a "{}" "artifacts/{}"' || true

          echo "Artifact listing:"
          find artifacts -type f -maxdepth 5 -exec ls -la {} \; || true

      - name: Upload Linux build artifacts
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: linux-build-artifacts
          path: |
            artifacts/**
